selected.title: Before the package lands
selected.texas_link: The FAA draft includes Austin in its proposed Texas delivery areas.

movement.action: opened public review of a draft assessment

selected.why_today: The October eleventh comment deadline is still ahead and the proposed delivery procedure is available for scrutiny.
selected.consequence: A recipient does not receive a package at a site that fails the described criteria.
selected.application_change: The described pod evaluates a target during descent and can stop the delivery or escalate the evaluation.
selected.counter_image: Applicant-prepared FAA-supervised draft. The proposed expansion needs FAA approval, and no observed delivery or success rate is claimed.
selected.earned_take: A package descending does not establish a completed delivery. The stopping condition can retract the pod.

agency.next_step: Interested residents can review the FAA draft and submit comments before its October eleventh deadline.
agency.who_can_act: Residents and other interested members of the public.

filmability.viewer_question: What happens when the place below the delivery pod is unsuitable?
filmability.opening_action: Tether unspools; pod descends toward a landing spot.
filmability.mechanism: Automatic lateral position control and spot evaluation; uncertain identification/evaluation sends an image to an operator.
filmability.human_consequence: Residents receive a parcel at a clear target; an unsuitable target ends the delivery without a parcel on the ground.
filmability.source_limit: Applicant-prepared FAA-supervised draft; not approval, measured reliability, observed delivery, or proof of injury avoidance.
three_key_images: A suspended pod above a generic delivery patch
A clear spot beside an unsuitable spot, with an operator image handoff
Parcel on ground versus pod retracting with parcel retained

asset_leads.inspection: Figure2.2-4 shows four aircraft profile views and a separate perspective of the aircraft with a pod suspended by a thin line. It establishes equipment geometry, not an observed Texas delivery.
asset_leads.rights_basis: Applicant artwork inside a federal-hosted document has no inspected reuse licence. Reference only; not admitted for film reuse.

asset_leads.inspection: Physical page51 describes automatic spot evaluation, operator image escalation and retraction after failed criteria. This is text evidence, not footage.
asset_leads.rights_basis: Short attributed editorial excerpt for discussing this exact proposal; no whole-page film treatment recommended.

visual_stakes.affected_person: Residents and package recipients in the five proposed Texas metropolitan areas
visual_stakes.physical_subject: A parcel inside a delivery pod on a winch line
visual_stakes.visible_change: Pod descends and releases payload on the clear branch; retracts without delivery on the unsuitable branch
visual_stakes.consequence: Suitability determines whether the package reaches the recipient
visual_stakes.opening_question: What happens when the place below the delivery pod is unsuitable?
visual_stakes.answer: The draft says failed criteria stop delivery and retract the pod; unresolved identification or suitability goes to an operator.
visual_stakes.asset_fit: Original source-backed physical illustration best explains descent, handoff and retraction; source profiles establish geometry only.

action_proposals.visible_action: An illustrated pod descends, steers above a target and transfers an image for review. A supported winch visibly takes in the tether to retract the retained pod from an unsuitable spot.
action_proposals.consequence: The illustrative package remains in its pod when the target fails the described criteria.
action_proposals.limits: Original explanatory geometry, not an actual aircraft, private interface, observed delivery, measured success rate or granted expansion. The operator review tray symbolizes image escalation only.
action_proposals.source_basis: The FAA draft describes winch descent, lateral control, delivery-location evaluation, operator image escalation and retraction when criteria are not met. The review notice establishes the proposed Austin operation and public deadline.

rejected.title: A machine scores the longer written answers on English STAAR first
rejected.reason: Authentic tangible workflow but the freshest September credit correction concerned text-entry answers the agency says were not graded by the engine. That movement risks conflating two scoring processes; paper routing pictures explain less physical action than the pod.
rejected.source_limit: December2023 scoring guidance is current source evidence for hybrid workflow, not primary evidence of September2026 correction.
